assumptions: Fresh extraction on the probed filesystem; existing destination contents are not inspected.
File-data lower bound assumes ordinary dense allocation, rounded per file to statvfs units; compression, sparse files, deduplication, and filesystem-specific allocation are not modeled.
Directory storage, filesystem metadata, baseline/runtime copies and concurrent usage need extra space.
Lexical POSIX paths only; filesystem name equivalence, permissions, quotas, payload CRC and local-header consistency are not verified. Unknown availability is JSON null, never infinity.
